hypotheses.M1_boundary_suppression_replicates: For both core channels, current-newline detection has negative-polarity AUROC at least 0.80 on every fresh corpus.
hypotheses.M2_product_is_more_boundary_selective_th: For each core channel and corpus, product signed AUROC exceeds the better individual factor by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.M3_newline_substitution_suppresses_core: Replacing an ordinary current token by newline lowers each core product in at least 75% of paired contexts on every corpus.
hypotheses.M4_pair_superadditivity_is_mostly_additi: For all-position and final-position ablations on every corpus, the synthetic additive-logit KL is within 20% of the exact pair KL and the nonlinear residual norm is at most 20% of pair logit-change norm.
hypotheses.M5_core_pair_has_positive_logit_coupling: The Fisher-centered cosine between the two individual logit changes is positive on average for both ablation scopes on every corpus.
hypotheses.M6_activation_predicts_individual_causal: For both core channels and every corpus, top-quartile absolute final activation has at least twice the mean exact KL of the bottom quartile.
hypotheses.M7_core_exceeds_matched_causal_effect: The exact pair KL is at least five times the matched-pair KL for both scopes on every corpus.
